start-vpn.why us section:
Deliver exceptional performance. For every request. Every time.

Never Make Your Users Wait Again.

01

Scalable By Design

Start small and add CPU, RAM and storage as you grow — upgrades take just a few clicks from your client area.

02

Tier 1 Global Network

Your traffic runs over premium carrier networks for stable, low-latency connections to visitors around the world.

03

NVMe + SSD Powered Servers

Enterprise NVMe and SSD storage delivers fast read and write speeds for websites, databases, applications and VPN workloads.

GlobalHostia Cache

Permanent Cache. Permanent Performance.

GlobalHostia Cache allows you to permanently store a copy of your files on our edge storage for a 100% cache HIT ratio. Experience maximum performance, even with uncached content.

SmartEdge

Bringing users where it matters.

SmartEdge™ routing engine uses real-time analytics based on your content and network metrics to make sure your users always end up at the most optimal destination.
